options.content:
- Use Cases: This dashboard shows the basic Git and Code Review metrics from GitLab.
- Data Source Required: GitLab

panels.description:
Issues created in the selected period.
datasource: issues, board_issues, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Issues created in the range.
SELECT COUNT(*) AS issue_count
FROM issues i
WHERE i.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi2 JOIN project_mapping pm2 ON pm2.row_id = bi2.board_id AND pm2.`table` = 'boards' WHERE bi2.issue_id = i.id AND bi2.board_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id})) AND pm2.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})));

panels.title: 1.1 Number of New Issues

panels.description:
Issues created per month or week.
datasource: issues, board_issues, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Issues created per month or week.
WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN '$interval' = 'WEEKDAY' THEN DATE_SUB(DATE(i.created_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(i.created_date) DAY) ELSE DATE_SUB(DATE(i.created_date), INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(i.created_date) - 1 DAY) END AS time,
         COUNT(*) AS issue_count
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi2 JOIN project_mapping pm2 ON pm2.row_id = bi2.board_id AND pm2.`table` = 'boards' WHERE bi2.issue_id = i.id AND bi2.board_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id})) AND pm2.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
  GROUP BY time
)
SELECT CASE WHEN '$interval' = 'DAYOFMONTH' THEN DATE_FORMAT(time, '%M %Y') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(time, 'W%v %x') END AS _time,
       issue_count AS "Issue Count"
FROM buckets
ORDER BY time;

panels.description:

datasource: issues, board_issues, project_mapping

-- Issues created in the range that are closed.

  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi2 JOIN project_mapping pm2 ON pm2.row_id = bi2.board_id AND pm2.`table` = 'boards' WHERE bi2.issue_id = i.id AND bi2.board_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id})) AND pm2.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})));

panels.title: 2.1 Number of Closed Issues

panels.description:
Open vs closed issues, grouped by creation month or week.
datasource: issues, board_issues, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Issues created per month or week, split by whether they are still open or now closed.
WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN '$interval' = 'WEEKDAY' THEN DATE_SUB(DATE(i.created_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(i.created_date) DAY) ELSE DATE_SUB(DATE(i.created_date), INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(i.created_date) - 1 DAY) END AS time,
         SUM(i.status <> 'DONE') AS open_issue_count,
         SUM(i.status = 'DONE')  AS closed_issue_count
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi2 JOIN project_mapping pm2 ON pm2.row_id = bi2.board_id AND pm2.`table` = 'boards' WHERE bi2.issue_id = i.id AND bi2.board_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id})) AND pm2.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
  GROUP BY time
)
SELECT CASE WHEN '$interval' = 'DAYOFMONTH' THEN DATE_FORMAT(time, '%M %Y') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(time, 'W%v %x') END AS _time,
       open_issue_count,
       closed_issue_count
FROM buckets
ORDER BY time;

panels.description:
Average lead time in days of issues closed in the period.
datasource: issues, board_issues, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Average lead time in days of issues closed in the range.
SELECT ROUND(AVG(i.lead_time_minutes / 1440), 1) AS issue_lead_time_in_days
FROM issues i
WHERE i.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
  AND i.status = 'DONE'
  AND i.lead_time_minutes > 0
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi2 JOIN project_mapping pm2 ON pm2.row_id = bi2.board_id AND pm2.`table` = 'boards' WHERE bi2.issue_id = i.id AND bi2.board_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id})) AND pm2.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})));

panels.title: 2.3 Mean Issue Lead Time by issue resolution time

panels.description:
Average lead time in days of issues closed per month or week.
datasource: issues, board_issues, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Average lead time in days of issues closed per month or week.
WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN '$interval' = 'WEEKDAY' THEN DATE_SUB(DATE(i.resolution_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(i.resolution_date) DAY) ELSE DATE_SUB(DATE(i.resolution_date), INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(i.resolution_date) - 1 DAY) END AS time,
         AVG(i.lead_time_minutes / 1440) AS issue_lead_time
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
    AND i.status = 'DONE'
    AND i.lead_time_minutes > 0
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi2 JOIN project_mapping pm2 ON pm2.row_id = bi2.board_id AND pm2.`table` = 'boards' WHERE bi2.issue_id = i.id AND bi2.board_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id})) AND pm2.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
  GROUP BY time
)
SELECT CASE WHEN '$interval' = 'DAYOFMONTH' THEN DATE_FORMAT(time, '%M %Y') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(time, 'W%v %x') END AS _time,
       ROUND(issue_lead_time, 1) AS "Mean Issue Lead Time in Days"
FROM buckets
ORDER BY time;

panels.title: 2.4 Mean issue lead time by issue resolution time

panels.description:
The 20 open issues waiting the longest, whatever the selected period.
datasource: issues, board_issues, boards, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Every open issue, whatever the selected time range (as the title says), longest waiting first. Top 20.
SELECT CONCAT('#', i.issue_key)                                  AS issue_key,
       i.title,
       i.url,
       ROUND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, i.created_date, NOW()) / 1440, 1) AS queue_time_in_days
FROM issues i
JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
JOIN boards b        ON b.id = bi.board_id
WHERE i.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND i.status <> 'DONE'
  AND bi.board_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = bi.board_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
ORDER BY queue_time_in_days DESC
LIMIT 20;

datasource: issues, board_issues, boards, project_mapping

FROM issues i
JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
JOIN boards b        ON b.id = bi.board_id
WHERE i.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND i.status <> 'DONE'
  AND bi.board_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = bi.board_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
ORDER BY queue_time_in_days DESC;

panels.description:
MRs created in the selected period, drafts excluded. MRs imported from GitHub and bot-authored MRs are left out; a Draft is an open MR whose title starts with Draft:, [Draft], (Draft), WIP: or [WIP].
datasource: pull_requests, pull_request_comments, accounts, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- MRs created in the range, drafts excluded.
-- MRs imported from GitHub (the not_imported_mr constant, shared with dashboards A and C) and bot-authored MRs are left out.
-- GitLab's is_draft is always 0, so a Draft is an open MR whose title starts with Draft:, [Draft], (Draft), WIP: or [WIP].
SELECT COUNT(*) AS merge_request_count
FROM pull_requests pr
WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
  AND NOT (pr.status = 'OPEN' AND LOWER(pr.title) REGEXP '^[[:space:]]*(draft:|\\[draft\\]|\\(draft\\)|wip:|\\[wip\\])')
  AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts ba WHERE ba.id = pr.author_id AND ba.user_name LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%')
  AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})));

panels.title: 3.2 Number of New Merge Requests

panels.description:
Top 20 authors by merged MRs created in the period. MRs imported from GitHub and bot-authored MRs are left out.
datasource: pull_requests, pull_request_comments, accounts, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Top 20 authors by MRs created in the range that are merged.
-- MRs imported from GitHub (the not_imported_mr constant, shared with dashboards A and C) and bot-authored MRs are left out.
SELECT COALESCE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(a.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), '')), '-', ' '), NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(pr.author_name)), ''), '(unmapped)') AS author_name,
       COUNT(*) AS merged_merge_request_count
FROM pull_requests pr
LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id
WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
  AND pr.status = 'MERGED'
  AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts ba WHERE ba.id = pr.author_id AND ba.user_name LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%')
  AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
GROUP BY pr.author_id, a.full_name, a.user_name
ORDER BY merged_merge_request_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: 3.3 Top 20 Contributors By Merged MRs

panels.description:
% of closed MRs that were closed without merging. MRs imported from GitHub and bot-authored MRs are left out.
datasource: pull_requests, pull_request_comments, accounts, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Share of closed MRs (merged or not) created in the range that were closed without merging.
-- MRs imported from GitHub (the not_imported_mr constant, shared with dashboards A and C) and bot-authored MRs are left out.
-- GitLab's is_draft is always 0, so a Draft is an open MR whose title starts with Draft:, [Draft], (Draft), WIP: or [WIP].
SELECT SUM(pr.status = 'CLOSED') / NULLIF(SUM(pr.status IN ('CLOSED', 'MERGED')), 0) AS ratio
FROM pull_requests pr
WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
  AND NOT (pr.status = 'OPEN' AND LOWER(pr.title) REGEXP '^[[:space:]]*(draft:|\\[draft\\]|\\(draft\\)|wip:|\\[wip\\])')
  AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts ba WHERE ba.id = pr.author_id AND ba.user_name LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%')
  AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})));

    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts ba WHERE ba.id = pr.author_id AND ba.user_name LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%')
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))

panels.title: 4.3 Number of MRs Closed without Merging

panels.description:
% of closed MRs not merged, per creation month or week. MRs imported from GitHub and bot-authored MRs are left out.
datasource: pull_requests, pull_request_comments, accounts, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Share of closed MRs created per month or week that were closed without merging.
-- The first bucket is dated at the range start, so its point isn't drawn left of the visible axis.
-- MRs imported from GitHub (the not_imported_mr constant, shared with dashboards A and C) and bot-authored MRs are left out.
-- GitLab's is_draft is always 0, so a Draft is an open MR whose title starts with Draft:, [Draft], (Draft), WIP: or [WIP].
SELECT GREATEST(CASE WHEN '$interval' = 'WEEKDAY' THEN DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.created_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.created_date) DAY) ELSE DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.created_date), INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(pr.created_date) - 1 DAY) END, DATE($__timeFrom())) AS time,
       SUM(pr.status = 'CLOSED') / NULLIF(SUM(pr.status IN ('CLOSED', 'MERGED')), 0) AS ratio
FROM pull_requests pr
WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
  AND NOT (pr.status = 'OPEN' AND LOWER(pr.title) REGEXP '^[[:space:]]*(draft:|\\[draft\\]|\\(draft\\)|wip:|\\[wip\\])')
  AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts ba WHERE ba.id = pr.author_id AND ba.user_name LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%')
  AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;

panels.title: 4.4 Ratio of unmerged MRs of All Closed MRs

panels.description:
Average days from creation to merge of MRs merged in the period. MRs imported from GitHub and bot-authored MRs are left out.
datasource: pull_requests, pull_request_comments, accounts, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Average days from creation to merge of MRs merged in the range, as on dashboards A and C.
-- MRs imported from GitHub (the not_imported_mr constant, shared with dashboards A and C) and bot-authored MRs are left out.
SELECT ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, pr.created_date, pr.merged_date) / 1440), 1) AS time_to_merge
FROM pull_requests pr
WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)
  AND pr.status = 'MERGED'
  AND pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL
  AND pr.merged_date > pr.created_date
  AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}

SELECT COALESCE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(a.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), '')), '-', ' '), NULLIF(TRIM(MAX(pr.author_name)), ''), '(unmapped)') AS "Author Name",
       COUNT(*) AS "Open Draft MR Count"
FROM pull_requests pr
LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id
WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
  AND (pr.status = 'OPEN' AND LOWER(pr.title) REGEXP '^[[:space:]]*(draft:|\\[draft\\]|\\(draft\\)|wip:|\\[wip\\])')
  AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts ba WHERE ba.id = pr.author_id AND ba.user_name LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%')
  AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
GROUP BY pr.author_id, a.full_name, a.user_name
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.description:
Overall unit test coverage of the selected repos from their latest SonarQube scan, whatever the selected period. Repos match SonarQube projects by full name, or by slug when no project has the full name.
datasource: cq_projects, repos, cq_file_metrics, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Unit test coverage from the latest SonarQube scan. File metrics are a snapshot of that scan and updated_at is only
-- DevLake's sync time, so the time range does not apply.
-- GitLab repos are matched to SonarQube projects by full name (group/repo); the repo slug is used only when no project
-- has the full name, so an unrelated project that shares the slug is never mixed in.
-- Each project's file metrics count once, even when the slug fallback matches it to several repos.
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cqp.id AS project_key
  FROM cq_projects cqp
  JOIN repos r ON r.name = cqp.name
               OR (SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.name, '/', -1) = cqp.name AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cq_projects x WHERE x.name = r.name))
  WHERE r.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND r.id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id = r.id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                   AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
)
SELECT ROUND((SUM(fm.lines_to_cover) - SUM(fm.uncovered_lines)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(fm.lines_to_cover), 0), 1) AS "Unit Test Coverage %"
FROM matched m
JOIN cq_file_metrics fm ON fm.project_key = m.project_key;

panels.title: 7.1 Aggregate Unit Test Coverage

panels.description:
MRs created in the period (50 newest, drafts included) with the current unit test coverage of their repo's SonarQube project. GitLab MRs carry no head commit, so coverage can't be tied to the MR's own commit. MRs imported from GitHub and bot-authored MRs are left out.
datasource: repos, cq_projects, cq_file_metrics, pull_requests, accounts, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- MRs created in the range (drafts included) with their repo's SonarQube coverage, newest first, capped at 50 rows.
-- GitLab repos are matched to SonarQube projects by full name (group/repo); the repo slug is used only when no project
-- has the full name, so an unrelated project that shares the slug is never mixed in.
-- An MR uses the project scanned at its head commit when there is one, else the repo's latest scanned project.
-- GitLab leaves head_commit_sha empty, so every MR falls back to the repo project and shows the repo's current coverage.
-- MRs imported from GitHub (the not_imported_mr constant, shared with dashboards A and C) and bot-authored MRs are left out.
WITH selected_repos AS (
  SELECT r.id, r.name AS repo_name, SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.name, '/', -1) AS repo_slug
  FROM repos r
  WHERE r.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND r.id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id = r.id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                   AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
),
project_coverage AS (
  SELECT cqp.id                                                    AS project_key,
         cqp.commit_sha,
         cqp.last_analysis_date,
         cqp.updated_at                                            AS project_updated_at,
         sr.repo_name,
         CASE WHEN cqp.name = sr.repo_name THEN 'full' ELSE 'slug' END AS match_type,
         COUNT(fm.id)                                              AS files,
         SUM(fm.lines_to_cover)                                    AS lines_to_cover,
         SUM(fm.uncovered_lines)                                   AS uncovered_lines
  FROM cq_projects cqp
  JOIN selected_repos sr ON sr.repo_name = cqp.name
                         OR (sr.repo_slug = cqp.name AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cq_projects x WHERE x.name = sr.repo_name))
  LEFT JOIN cq_file_metrics fm ON fm.project_key = cqp.id
  GROUP BY cqp.id, cqp.commit_sha, cqp.last_analysis_date, cqp.updated_at, sr.repo_name,
           CASE WHEN cqp.name = sr.repo_name THEN 'full' ELSE 'slug' END
),
repo_project AS (
  SELECT pc.*,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pc.repo_name
                            ORDER BY pc.match_type = 'full' DESC, COALESCE(pc.last_analysis_date, pc.project_updated_at) DESC, pc.files DESC, pc.project_key DESC) AS rn
  FROM project_coverage pc
),
mrs AS (
  SELECT pr.pull_request_key, pr.title, COALESCE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(a.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), '')), '-', ' '), NULLIF(TRIM(pr.author_name), ''), '(unmapped)') AS author, pr.status, pr.created_date, pr.url, pr.head_commit_sha,
         r.name AS repo_name
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN repos r         ON r.id = pr.base_repo_id
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id
  WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
    AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts ba WHERE ba.id = pr.author_id AND ba.user_name LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%')
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                   AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
)
SELECT CAST(mr.pull_request_key AS UNSIGNED)                         AS "MR Number",
       mr.title                                                      AS "MR Title",
       mr.author                                                     AS "Author",
       CASE UPPER(mr.status) WHEN 'OPEN' THEN 'Open' WHEN 'MERGED' THEN 'Merged' WHEN 'CLOSED' THEN 'Closed' ELSE mr.status END AS "Status",
       mr.created_date                                               AS "Created Date",
       mr.url                                                        AS "MR URL",
       COALESCE(exact.project_key, rp.project_key)                   AS "SonarQube Project",
       CASE
         WHEN exact.project_key IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('MR commit match', CASE WHEN exact.match_type = 'slug' THEN ' (slug)' ELSE '' END)
         WHEN rp.project_key IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('Repo project fallback', CASE WHEN rp.match_type = 'slug' THEN ' (slug)' ELSE '' END)
         ELSE 'No SonarQube project'
       END                                                           AS "Coverage Source",
       COALESCE(exact.files, rp.files)                               AS "Files Scanned",
       COALESCE(exact.lines_to_cover, rp.lines_to_cover)             AS "Lines To Cover",
       ROUND((COALESCE(exact.lines_to_cover, rp.lines_to_cover) - COALESCE(exact.uncovered_lines, rp.uncovered_lines)) * 100.0
             / NULLIF(COALESCE(exact.lines_to_cover, rp.lines_to_cover), 0), 1) AS "Current Repo Coverage",
       CASE
         WHEN exact.project_key IS NULL AND rp.project_key IS NULL THEN 'No SonarQube project matched this repo by full repo name or slug'
         WHEN exact.project_key IS NULL THEN 'No MR commit match; showing repository SonarQube project status'
         WHEN COALESCE(exact.lines_to_cover, rp.lines_to_cover) IS NULL THEN 'No SonarQube file metrics'
         WHEN COALESCE(exact.lines_to_cover, rp.lines_to_cover) = 0 THEN 'SonarQube imported files, but no LCOV lines_to_cover'
         ELSE 'Coverage available'
       END                                                           AS "Coverage Data Status"
FROM mrs mr
LEFT JOIN project_coverage exact ON exact.commit_sha = mr.head_commit_sha AND mr.head_commit_sha <> '' AND exact.repo_name = mr.repo_name
LEFT JOIN repo_project rp        ON rp.repo_name = mr.repo_name AND rp.rn = 1
ORDER BY mr.created_date DESC
LIMIT 50;
